manifest.description: Run one Badgey consultant turn through the consultant atom backend. Without consultant_id the invocation opens a new Badgey instance using brief/prompt as the initial brief; with consultant_id (and prompt) it resumes that instance for one turn. The instance outlives the invocation — pass the returned consultant_id to subsequent invocations to continue the same consultation.
when_to_use: running a Badgey consultation turn from a workflow atom binding instead of a badgey_* mcp_call
opening a consultant instance whose id later turns (and other atoms) can resume
composing consultant turns under atom ownership, effects, and budget accounting
anti_patterns: do not use for the proposal apply path — use consultant_proposal_begin_apply / consultant_proposal_complete_apply
do not treat the invocation as the consultation: the instance persists after the turn and must be dismissed via badgey_dismiss when done

consultant_id.description: Existing instance to resume (omit to open a new instance)

prompt.description: Turn prompt (required with consultant_id; used as the brief when opening without one)

brief.description: Initial brief when opening a new instance

project_dir.description: Project scope for a new instance
